title: お正月飾りの白黒線画
subject_en: New Year decorations and games in clean black outline only on a white background, no fill colour and no shading, thick even line, closed shapes, each a separate subject, monochrome-print friendly Outlines are closed and darker than the fill; light parts (snow, paper, white fur, plates) are warm cream (#FFF6E0) or tinted, never pure white. No letters, no text, no logos.
lead: 門松・鏡餅・しめ縄・破魔矢・羽子板・凧・独楽・おせち・初日の出などお正月の飾りと遊びを、黒い線だけで描いた12点の素材です。白黒の年賀状や、モノクロ印刷のおたよりに使えます。
items: a pair-style kadomatsu of cut bamboo and pine branches tied with straw rope
a kagami mochi of two stacked round rice cakes on a stand with a bitter orange on top and a leaf
a New Year shimenawa wreath with paper streamers, a bitter orange and fern leaves
a hamaya arrow with feather fletching and a decorated shaft
a hagoita paddle with a decorated panel and a shuttlecock
a kite with a long tail flying, with a simple pattern
a spinning top with a wide pattern and a string
a tiered osechi lunch box seen from above with several small dishes in it
the first sunrise over mountains with a pine tree in front
a daruma doll with a round body and a simple face
a votive plaque and a shrine bell with a rope
a bowl of soba noodles with a tempura shrimp and chopsticks, steam rising
